evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC precondition validation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Prevents a daemon assertion crash when calling `dumptxoutset` with rollback on pruned assumeutxo nodes. As stated in the PR description, 'Loading a UTXO snapshot on a pruned node can leave the active tip without block or undo data. Attempting a rollback with dumptxoutset then triggers an assertion and terminates the node.' Returning a clean RPC error instead of terminating the process fixes a clear reliability issue in the RPC interface.
